faq.metaDesc: Answers to common questions about Clubero — pricing, setup, GDPR, parental controls and more.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Contact us — we're happy to help.

items.q: Who is Clubero for?
items.a: Clubero is built for amateur sports clubs. Coaches, club staff, parents and players each get a tailored experience.

items.q: Which sports are covered?
items.a: In V1, Clubero covers 8 team sports with score entry and sport-specific player stats: football, futsal, basketball, rugby, handball, volleyball, ice hockey and field hockey. More sports are coming — tell us which one you're missing.

items.q: Is there a free offer?
items.a: Yes. Our Discovery offer gives you a 30-day free trial with no credit card, for one team up to 25 members. Move to the Club plan when you need more teams or features.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a club?
items.a: Most clubs are operational in under an hour. Guided onboarding is included with the Club and Federation plans.

items.q: How do you handle minors and parental consent?
items.a: Players under 18 can be linked to one or more parent accounts. By default, parents control responses and visibility on their child's behalf.

items.q: Where is data stored?
items.a: All club data is hosted on European infrastructure and Clubero is GDPR-compliant. Members can request an export or deletion at any time.

items.q: Can I import my existing roster?
items.a: Yes. We support CSV import during onboarding, and our team can help you migrate from spreadsheets or other tools.

items.q: Does Clubero work on mobile?
items.a: Clubero is mobile-first. It works in any modern browser and can be installed as a PWA on iOS and Android for a native experience.

items.q: How do I get help?
items.a: Email support is included on every plan. The Club and Federation plans get priority support and dedicated onboarding.

items.q: Do you really have an AI to create my events?
items.a: Yes. Instead of filling out a long form, a guided assistant asks the right questions (team, type, date, opponent, meeting point…) and creates the draft for a match, training, tournament or meeting. You stay in control: nothing is published without your approval. The conversational assistant can also create a draft from chat ('Create the U13 call-up for Saturday 2:30 PM').

items.q: And what about organising a tournament?
items.a: The tournament assistant recommends the right format (pools + finals, knockout, Swiss, mixed) from a handful of answers: number of teams, available duration, courts, multiple trophies or not, paid or free. It computes the number of matches, the estimated end time and the number of courts you should plan. You stay in control to adjust before launching.

items.q: Can I collect membership fees in Clubero?
items.a: Not yet. Club payments (Stripe Connect, HelloAsso, membership fees, prize pools) are being finalised and will be available soon. In the meantime, you can track payment obligations and manage your collections outside the app.

items.q: Can I organise a paid tournament?
items.a: Yes. Paid tournament registrations are available today, with integrated secure payment, whether your club is subscribed or you are organising a one-off tournament.

items.q: What tournament formats are supported?
items.a: Pools + finals, single elimination, double elimination, Swiss system and flights (level-based distribution). Enough to cover almost all amateur competitions.

items.q: How does GDPR work at Clubero?
items.a: Each member can request to export their data or delete their account. Sensitive documents (e.g., internship certificates) are automatically purged after the legal period, and data is hosted in Europe.

items.q: Can I customise my club's colours?
items.a: Yes. Each club can define its own brand colour, which is automatically applied to its public pages (tournaments, training camps, club wall).

parentGuide.title: Get started with Clubero in minutes.
parentGuide.subtitle: Everything a parent needs to follow their child: call-ups, absences, notifications and the club wall.
parentGuide.tutorialsSubtitle: Eight detailed, step-by-step procedures with a screenshot for each step.

tutorials.b: It all starts with your club's invitation. Set up your access in a few minutes.
steps: Open your club's invitation email and tap "Accept invitation".
Enter your first and last name, then create your password (your email is already pre-filled). Tap "Create account".
Review and accept the consents (privacy, terms, notifications, data processing), then "Accept and continue".
You land straight on your club's home screen — you're logged in.
Open the "Profile" tab: you'll see your info, language and notifications.
Check your first name, last name and phone number. If needed, update any relevant information, then tap "Save".

tutorials.b: Review your child's information and, if you wish, give them access to their own player space. You stay in control.
steps: Receive the email letting you know your child has been linked to your account.
Open the "Teams" tab and select your child at the top of the list.
Review their information: first name, last name and position.
Scroll down to see their licence number, phone and email.
Check the platform access permission and the parents' details.
Turn on your child's platform access with the toggle.
Send the invitation to the player: your child needs their own email address. They'll get an email to create a password and access their team's data.
Tick "Can respond to call-ups (Player)" to let them respond themselves — otherwise, only parents can respond to call-ups.

tutorials.t: See events and respond to a call-up
tutorials.b: Get call-ups by email, notification or in the app, and respond for your child in one tap.
steps: Receive the call-up by email: confirm attendance (Present / Uncertain / Absent) directly from the email.
You also get a push notification that takes you straight into the app.
Without logging in to the app, the page opened from the email confirms your choice. Your response is sent to the coach immediately, helping them prepare the event with confidence.
On the home screen, the "Insights" card reminds you of actions to take. The home screen also shows up to the next three events your child has been called up for.
The "Events" page contains all upcoming events scheduled for the team. A green badge identifies those your child has been called up for; use "Filters" to show only the events you want.
Open the event details: match info and your response (Present / Uncertain / Absent).
For an absence or if unsure, add a reason (preset or free text) sent to the coach.
Each event has its own chat: authorised parents, players and coaches can clarify anything relating to the match. With every new message, authorised participants receive a push notification.

tutorials.b: Turn on push notifications to receive call-ups, reminders, cancellations, rescheduled events and new Wall posts, according to your club's settings.
steps: In the "Profile" menu, open the notifications section to enable them.
Tap "Enable": a window opens — allow notifications.
Notifications show as enabled: push will now be sent to this phone.

tutorials.b: Let the staff know ahead of time when your child can't make it: the coach is notified and the schedule is updated.
steps: From the app home, tap "Report an absence".
Another way: open "Teams" then your child's profile.
Open the report-an-absence screen.
Select the date range concerned.
Choose the reason, add a comment if needed, then save: the coach is notified and the team schedule is updated.
The absence appears in the "Availability" tab of your child's profile.
You can cancel it via "Cancel" in the history section.

tutorials.b: For matches and trainings, book a seat or request a ride directly from the event.
steps: Open a match or a training where carpooling is enabled (the coach turns it on event by event).
Find the "Carpooling" card (with the responsibility reminder): you'll see the available offers.
Tap "Book a seat" on an offer to confirm your seat.
See which player is assigned to which car; you can cancel your booking and discuss the details in the event chat.
No ride available? Tap "Request a ride".
Confirm, and add a comment if needed.
Your request appears in the event; the coach is notified by email, along with the other parents and players.

tutorials.b: The Wall is your club's news feed: announcements, posts, polls — and soon the club's social media.
steps: Open the "Wall" tab: you'll find the club's and coach's announcements and posts (messages, attachments, polls — and, by September 2026, the club's Instagram/Facebook posts).
Whenever there's a new post, you get a push notification.
And, depending on the club, possibly an email.
Interact with posts by leaving a message (if comments are enabled).
For a poll, tap "Vote", select your answer and confirm.
Your vote is saved: see the live results.
You can change your vote anytime (unless the poll is anonymous).

tutorials.b: Offer your help with refreshments, refereeing, transport or any other task organised by the club.
steps: When a coach posts a need, parents, players or both receive an email, depending on the target audience.
Open the event, then the "Helping hands" tab to see the details. Indicate whether or not you are available.
If you are available, tap "Volunteer". Your participation is confirmed immediately or placed on hold for the coach's approval, then appears as "Confirmed".
From the bottom of the home page, open "My helping hands" to find the needs you were invited to, regardless of your response.
This page lists all your needs: you can respond directly and see which ones are confirmed.
You will also find the needs for which you indicated that you were unavailable.
When the coach accepts a pending offer, you receive a confirmation email.

items.q: I haven't received my invitation.
items.a: First check your spam or junk folder. If you still cannot find it, ask your coach to check your email address or resend the invitation.

items.q: I've changed my email address.
items.a: Your email address is visible in Profile, but it cannot be changed in the app. If you no longer have access to the old address, contact support from the app or email support@clubero.app.

items.q: I've forgotten my password.
items.a: Use "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen. You will receive an email allowing you to set a new password.

items.q: Can my partner access our child's account?
items.a: Yes. Each parent can have their own account and be linked to the same child by the club.

items.q: We have several children at the club.
items.a: You can access several children from a single parent account, provided their profiles have been linked correctly by the club.

items.q: Can my child have their own account?
items.a: Yes, if a parent enables platform access. The child must have their own email address to receive the invitation and create their password.

items.q: How do I respond to a call-up?
items.a: Open the call-up, then choose "Present", "Absent" or "Uncertain". You can also respond directly from certain call-up emails.

items.q: I selected the wrong response.
items.a: You can change your response provided the coach has not locked responses and the event has not passed or been cancelled.

items.q: Why hasn't my child been called up?
items.a: Call-ups are managed by the coaches. If your child does not appear, contact the coach directly.

items.q: Why can't I see the list of called-up players?
items.a: The club may hide the full list of called-up players from parents and players. In that case, you will mainly see your own child's call-up.

items.q: Why should I respond quickly?
items.a: Your response helps the coach prepare the squad, organise the event and plan for absences.

items.q: Can I respond directly from the email I receive?
items.a: Yes. When the email contains response buttons, one click is enough and you do not need to sign in to the app. The response is sent to the coach immediately.

items.q: Where can I find upcoming training sessions and matches?
items.a: The "Events" page brings together upcoming events scheduled for the team. The home screen also shows up to your child's next three call-ups.

items.q: A match time has changed.
items.a: Changes are updated automatically. Called-up players and their parents receive an in-app alert and an email; push notifications depend on the club's settings.

items.q: Can I add events to my personal calendar?
items.a: Not currently. Clubero provides its calendar in the app, but does not yet automatically sync events with your phone's calendar.

items.q: What is an event chat for?
items.a: It allows authorised parents, players and coaches to discuss the logistics of that event. With every new message, authorised participants receive a push notification.

items.q: I'm not receiving any notifications.
items.a: Check in Profile that notifications are enabled, then make sure your phone allows Clubero to send you notifications.

items.q: Will I receive too many notifications?
items.a: Push notifications are enabled or disabled for the whole device: you cannot choose each type in Profile. The club decides which types of push notification are sent to its members.

items.q: Will I be notified if an event is cancelled or rescheduled?
items.a: Yes. Called-up players and their parents receive an in-app alert and an email. The push notification depends on the settings defined by the club.

items.q: Will I be notified about a new Wall post?
items.a: A push notification may be sent depending on the club's settings. The club may also choose to send an email.

items.q: What does "Event needs" mean?
items.a: The club may be looking for volunteers to help with refreshments, refereeing, transport or other roles. You can volunteer directly in the app.

items.q: How can I help the club?
items.a: When a need is posted, open it and tap "Volunteer" to choose the role or task.

items.q: I volunteered but am no longer available.
items.a: You can withdraw your offer while the need is still open and your participation is pending or confirmed.

items.q: Who can see my child's information?
items.a: Only people authorised by your club, such as the relevant administrators and coaches, can access the information needed to organise activities.

items.q: Can other parents see my contact details?
items.a: No. Your contact details are not shown to other parents; they are accessible to your account and authorised people at the club.

items.q: Can I delete my account?
items.a: Yes. In Profile → Privacy & data, request deletion of your account. It is scheduled and processed by the Clubero team; you can cancel the request while it is still in progress.

items.q: What is the club Wall for?
items.a: The Wall allows the club and coaches to share messages, attachments, announcements, polls and news with families.

items.q: How do I report a problem?
items.a: Use the Support section in the app or ask your club to pass on the problem. You can also email support@clubero.app.

faq.q: Do we have to recreate everything manually?

faq.q: Do we need any special tools?

faq.q: What if our data lives in several files?
faq.a: No problem. We consolidate and structure everything for you before the import.

faq.q: Does it work with limited internet on the field?
faq.a: The referee mobile interface is lightweight and works on 3G/4G. Score updates sync as soon as the connection is back.

faq.q: Can I change the schedule during the tournament?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can reschedule, swap fields, or adjust times in seconds. The public page and TV mode update instantly.

faq.q: Is there a limit on the number of teams?
faq.a: No hard limit. Clubero handles tournaments from 4 to 100+ teams with automatic scheduling.

faq.q: Can spectators follow without an account?
faq.a: Yes. The public page is accessible to anyone via a link or QR code — no signup required.

faq.q: How does the TV mode work?
faq.a: Open the dedicated TV link on any screen (smart TV, projector, laptop). It displays live standings, upcoming matches and current scores in full screen — zero installation.
